method: Comment-stripped balanced-argument static parse; macro parameters ignored; both sisi branches inventoried; etiquette adds label and sga4.semantic destination. Does not expand arbitrary TeX macros, execute conditionals or audit bibliography citations.
active_setting: original=false, consistent with selected reader; literal sisi branches resolved with positions retained; other TeX conditionals not executed
limitations: Static literal target audit is not a TeX expansion or compilation.
A declared target can have the wrong mathematical meaning; 41 numeric-display candidates remain for editorial review.
Bibliographic cite requests, implicit automatic equation/page anchors and arbitrary user-defined macro expansions not audited.
